summary.en: Amigo Tech built an AI platform automating medical workflows for clinics and practices.

overview.en: Amigo Tech launched Amigo Intelligence, a platform based on Google AI technologies that automates medical processes for clinics and practices. The solution includes anamnesis automation, advanced exam analysis, and a medical AI chatbot, transforming healthcare management and reducing operational costs.

en: Automated anamnesis (patient history collection) to reduce physician administrative burden.
Advanced AI-powered exam analysis integrated into clinical workflows.
Medical AI chatbot supports patient and practitioner interactions.
Platform reduces costs and improves efficiency for clinics and practices.
zh: 自動化病史採集，減輕醫師行政負擔。
將進階 AI 驅動的檢查分析整合進臨床工作流程。
醫療 AI 聊天機器人支援患者與醫療人員互動。
平台降低診所與醫療機構的成本並提升效率。

overview.en: Apollo Hospitals in India partnered with Google Health to build AI screening models for tuberculosis and breast cancer. Facing a critical shortage of radiologists, the collaboration deployed AI to help a limited pool of specialists cover far more patients at risk, scaling to 3 million screenings within a few years.

en: Scaled AI-assisted screenings to 3 million within a matter of years across India.
AI models assist radiologists in interpreting chest X-rays for TB detection and mammograms for breast cancer.
Addresses critical radiologist shortage to extend specialist-level care to underserved populations.
Partnership helps India tackle tuberculosis, which causes over 1.3 million deaths globally per year.
zh: 數年內在印度全境擴展至 300 萬次 AI 輔助篩檢。
AI 模型協助放射科醫師判讀胸部 X 光片（肺結核）及乳房攝影（乳癌）。
解決放射科醫師嚴重短缺問題，將專科水準的照護延伸至醫療資源不足地區。
此合作協助印度對抗肺結核——每年全球逾 130 萬人死於此疾病。

Creates data-driven clinical decision support at one of the world's leading medical centers.
Transforms complex oncology patient data into actionable clinical insights.

在全球頂尖醫療中心建立數據驅動的臨床決策支援系統。

overview.en: Atropos Health, a healthcare data analytics company, optimized its GENEVA OS to work with Google Cloud's Healthcare Data Engine (HDE) and BigQuery. This enables healthcare customers to efficiently and securely convert their data into valuable clinical insights and real-world evidence. Upon installation, customers can ask clinical questions and receive observational study-grade evidence within 48 hours.

en: GENEVA OS integrates with Google Cloud Healthcare Data Engine APIs and BigQuery for secure data analysis.
Customers can receive observational publication-grade clinical evidence within 48 hours of asking a question.
Alexandria library provides access to tens of thousands of existing studies available from day one.
Available through Google Cloud Marketplace for streamlined enterprise access.
zh: GENEVA OS 整合 Google Cloud Healthcare Data Engine API 與 BigQuery，實現安全資料分析。
客戶可在 48 小時內獲得達觀察性發表等級的臨床實證。
Alexandria 資料庫從第一天起即提供數萬份現有研究。

Differentiated pipeline of novel drug candidates derived from AI-driven analysis.
Clinical-stage company applying AI to accelerate progression from discovery to trials.

overview.en: Bayer built a data agent that uses generative AI in BigQuery to predict flu outbreaks. The agent combines Google Search trends with internal data to deliver real-time, location-specific healthcare planning insights. This approach allows Bayer to proactively respond to seasonal health demand shifts across markets.

en: Gen AI data agent built in BigQuery combines Search trends with internal data for flu outbreak prediction.
Delivers real-time, location-specific insights for healthcare planning.
Marketing campaigns optimized using predictive model achieved 85% increase in click-through rates year-on-year.
Cost per click reduced by 33% compared to the previous year through AI-driven demand forecasting.
zh: 在 BigQuery 建立的生成式 AI 資料代理，結合搜尋趨勢與內部資料預測流感疫情。
提供即時的地區特定醫療規劃洞察。
採用預測模型優化的行銷活動點擊率年增 85%。

summary.en: Bayer and Google Cloud collaborated to apply TPUs to accelerate quantum chemistry calculations for early drug discovery.
summary.zh: Bayer 與 Google Cloud 合作，運用 TPU 加速量子化學計算，推進早期藥物研發。

overview.en: Bayer and Google Cloud announced a collaboration to drive early drug discovery by applying AI-specialized Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) to accelerate and scale Bayer's quantum chemistry calculations. The collaboration aims to demonstrate fully quantum mechanical modeling of protein-ligand interactions, enabling more accurate in silico identification of novel drug candidates.
overview.zh: Bayer 與 Google Cloud 宣布合作，運用 AI 專用張量處理器（TPU）加速並擴展 Bayer 的量子化學計算，以推進早期藥物研發。此合作旨在實現蛋白質-配體相互作用的全量子力學建模，使新型候選藥物的電腦模擬識別更加精準。

en: Google Cloud TPUs applied to accelerate Bayer's quantum chemistry calculations for drug discovery.
Goal of achieving fully in silico quantum mechanical modeling of protein-ligand binding.
Density functional theory (DFT) calculations run at scale to evaluate drug candidates more accurately.
Collaboration announced January 2023 to determine scientific and economic viability of large-scale DFT for drug discovery.
zh: 運用 Google Cloud TPU 加速 Bayer 用於藥物研發的量子化學計算。
目標是實現蛋白質-配體結合的全電腦模擬量子力學建模。
大規模運行密度泛函理論（DFT）計算，更精準評估候選藥物。
2023 年 1 月宣布合作，以確定大規模 DFT 用於藥物研發的科學與經濟可行性。

overview.en: Beep Saúde, the largest home health company in Brazil, implemented an AI-powered last-mile dynamic routing system with Google Maps Platform to optimize operations and manage a 10% cancellation volume. The company also uses AI to speed up processing of medical orders, reduce costs, and support expansion plans. The system handles more than 50,000 home visits per month.
overview.zh: 巴西最大居家醫療公司 Beep Saúde 導入結合 Google Maps Platform 的 AI 驅動最後一哩動態路線規劃系統，優化營運並管理 10% 的取消率。公司還運用 AI 加速醫療訂單處理、降低成本，並支持在巴西的擴張計畫。系統每月處理逾 5 萬次上門服務。

en: AI-powered Route Optimization via Google Maps Platform handles 50,000+ home visits per month.
Dynamic routing adapts in real time to cancellations, reschedules, and last-minute bookings.
Routes consider traffic conditions, procedure duration, and nurse shift limits.
Target of scaling to 250,000 monthly home visits supported by AI logistics infrastructure.
zh: 透過 Google Maps Platform 的 AI 路線優化，每月處理逾 5 萬次上門服務。
動態路線即時應對取消、改期和臨時預約。
路線規劃考量交通狀況、操作程序時長及護士班次限制。
以 AI 物流基礎架構支援每月 25 萬次上門服務的擴張目標。

Digital broker channel eliminates manual bureaucracy in insurance processes.
Improved operational efficiency accelerates business closure for insurance brokers.
Platform integrates Google Cloud, Dialogflow, and Gemini Pro for intelligent automation.

Efficient model adaptation reduces development time for deploying new clinical AI applications.

利用 Gemini 小樣本泛化能力快速適應新診斷任務。

Targets proteins with aberrant function to enable small molecule corrector drug development.
Computationally driven approach accelerates discovery of hard-to-drug protein targets.

Generated R$6.4 million in annual savings from the infrastructure modernization.
Physicians gained access to complete patient exam history across the network.

overview.en: Moonwalk Bio, a preclinical-stage biotechnology company, leverages epigenetic biology and AI to pioneer new medicines for obesity and cardiometabolic disease. Their platform determines the causal relationships between genes and disease pathways for therapeutic targeting, using computational approaches to identify novel drug targets in traditionally difficult-to-treat conditions.

en: Leverages epigenetic biology and AI to identify causal gene-disease relationships for drug targeting.
Focuses on obesity and cardiometabolic diseases — major unmet medical needs.
Preclinical platform uses computational analysis to select the most promising therapeutic targets.
AI-driven approach could accelerate early-stage drug discovery for metabolic disease.
zh: 結合表觀遺傳學生物學與 AI，識別用於藥物靶點的基因-疾病因果關係。
專注於肥胖症及心臟代謝疾病——重大未滿足醫療需求。
臨床前平台運用計算分析選取最具潛力的治療靶點。
AI 驅動方法可加速代謝疾病的早期藥物研發。

en: AI reduces ECG report turnaround time to approximately 2 minutes.
Assists clinics and hospitals in managing cardiovascular diagnostic data and reports.
Accelerates cardiovascular care workflows for faster clinical decision-making.
Brazilian startup addressing a critical diagnostic bottleneck in cardiology.

協助診所與醫院管理心血管診斷資料與報告。
加速心血管照護工作流程，支援更快速的臨床決策。

The platform enables researchers to analyze biomedical data at scale and identify hidden relationships buried in scientific literature, accelerating hypothesis generation and drug discovery.

en: Gemini and Vertex AI power large-scale analysis of biomedical data for life sciences research.
Identifies hidden relationships and connections buried in scientific literature.
Accelerates hypothesis generation and knowledge discovery for pharmaceutical researchers.
Bridges data analysis and literature mining into a unified research intelligence platform.

識別科學文獻中隱藏的關聯與連結。
加速製藥研究人員的假設生成與知識發現。
將資料分析與文獻挖掘整合為統一的研究智能平台。

en: Google Kubernetes Engine provides flexibility and scalability for large-scale protein structure analysis.
Designs, processes, and analyzes data for large numbers of protein structures computationally.
Enables AI-driven drug discovery at scales previously not feasible.
Increased scalability supports expansion into new, larger AI research projects.

計算設計、處理和分析大量蛋白質結構的資料。
支援以前無法實現的規模 AI 驅動藥物研發。
增強的可擴展性支持擴展至更大型的 AI 研究專案。

en: Cloud-based gen AI implementation reduced service costs by approximately 89%.
End consumers benefit from approximately 50% cost savings.
Modernized personalized auditory stimulation training with AI.
Demonstrates significant cost efficiency gains from cloud AI adoption in digital health.

最終消費者受益於約 50% 的費用節省。
以 AI 現代化個人化聽覺刺激訓練。
展示數位健康領域採用雲端 AI 的顯著成本效益提升。

Reduces processing time and administrative burden for healthcare claims.
Accelerates reimbursement timelines for healthcare providers.
Document AI applied to a critical healthcare revenue cycle workflow.

減少醫療保險理賠的處理時間和行政負擔。

The platform processes more than 65 petabytes of data, runs up to 2.2 million experiments a week, and has already pushed some target discovery programs to preclinical studies in just 18 months while cutting the cost of model inference by as much as 50%.

Runs up to 2.2 million drug discovery experiments per week.
Some target discovery programs advanced to preclinical studies in just 18 months.
Model inference cost cut by up to 50% using Cloud TPUs.

每週最多執行 220 萬次藥物研發實驗。
部分靶點發現計畫在短短 18 個月內推進至臨床前研究。

Improved accessibility of medical care for patients across the Chilean network.
Reduced operational costs through AI-driven data analysis and decision support.
Generates measurable organizational value from data modernization.

提升智利網絡中患者的醫療可及性。
透過 AI 驅動的資料分析和決策支援降低運營成本。

summary.zh: Rezo Therapeutics 運用 Gemini 模型、GPU、TPU 及 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform，快速生成結構解析的蛋白質複合物，大幅加速靶點發現。

overview.en: Rezo Therapeutics is a Google Cloud-native oncology company that uses AI to map protein-protein interactions — the complex biological networks that drive cancer — in pursuit of small-molecule drugs for 'undruggable' targets. By leveraging Gemini models, GPUs, TPUs, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Rezo can rapidly generate large numbers of structurally resolved protein complexes, significantly accelerating target discovery compared to conventional approaches.
overview.zh: Rezo Therapeutics 是一家 Google Cloud 原生腫瘤學公司，運用 AI 繪製驅動癌症的複雜蛋白質-蛋白質相互作用網絡，追求針對「難以成藥」靶點的小分子藥物。借助 Gemini 模型、GPU、TPU 及 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform，Rezo 能夠快速生成大量結構解析的蛋白質複合物，相較傳統方法大幅加速靶點發現。

en: Rapidly generates large numbers of structurally resolved protein complexes.
Significantly accelerates target discovery compared to conventional approaches.
Targets historically 'undruggable' proteins through protein-protein interaction mapping.
Uses Gemini models, GPUs, TPUs, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform on Google Cloud.
zh: 快速生成大量結構解析的蛋白質複合物。
相較傳統方法大幅加速靶點發現。
透過蛋白質-蛋白質相互作用繪製，針對歷來「難以成藥」的蛋白質。
在 Google Cloud 上使用 Gemini 模型、GPU、TPU 及 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform。

Google Cloud infrastructure supports high-performance computational chemistry.

summary.en: Schrödinger migrated to Google Cloud, completing complex drug discovery calculations in hours instead of weeks and screening billions of compounds in a single weekend.
summary.zh: Schrödinger 遷移至 Google Cloud 後，複雜藥物研發計算從數週縮短至數小時，單一週末即可篩選數十億化合物。

Complex calculations that previously took weeks can now be completed in hours, enabling researchers to explore billions of possible compounds in a single weekend and potentially shortening multi-year drug discovery programs to months.

en: Complex drug discovery calculations now completed in hours instead of weeks on Google Cloud.
Researchers can explore billions of possible compounds in a single weekend.
Potential to shorten multi-year drug discovery programs to months.
BigQuery enables near-instantaneous analysis of molecular properties.
zh: 在 Google Cloud 上，複雜藥物研發計算從數週縮短至數小時。
研究人員可在單一週末內探索數十億種可能化合物。

Automates administrative tasks to free clinician time for patient care.

Provides 2,500+ academic institutions access to NIH datasets and Google Cloud services.
Over 425 research programs and projects have leveraged cloud resources through STRIDES.
Supports AI/ML for medical image analysis, disease prediction, population health analytics, and more.

為逾 2,500 家學術機構提供 NIH 資料集與 Google Cloud 服務存取。
逾 425 個研究計畫透過 STRIDES 使用了雲端資源。

overview.en: Triplebar, a biotechnology company, is building a genome-scale AI model for therapeutic production. Using a proprietary miniaturization process, they can test billions of cellular mutations at once, creating large datasets to train generative AI and inform new treatments.
overview.zh: 生物技術公司 Triplebar 正在為治療藥物生產建立基因組規模 AI 模型。利用專有微型化流程，他們能夠同時測試數十億個細胞突變，創建大型資料集來訓練生成式 AI 並指導新療法的研發。

en: Proprietary miniaturization process enables simultaneous testing of billions of cellular mutations.
Large-scale mutation testing generates datasets to train genome-scale generative AI models.
AI models trained on massive cellular datasets inform development of new therapeutic interventions.
Genome-scale approach enables comprehensive coverage of potential therapeutic targets.

大規模突變測試生成訓練基因組規模生成式 AI 模型的資料集。
基於海量細胞資料集訓練的 AI 模型指導新治療干預方案的研發。
基因組規模方法全面覆蓋潛在治療靶點。

Partners with Google Cloud to deliver scalable, enterprise-ready bioinformatics capabilities.
Accelerates discoveries across the drug development pipeline.

summary.en: Virgo Surgical stores 1.75 PB of endoscopy video on Google Cloud and used it to create EndoDINO, an AI foundation model for endoscopy.
summary.zh: Virgo Surgical 在 Google Cloud 儲存 1.75 PB 的內視鏡影片，並以此資料建立內視鏡 AI 基礎模型 EndoDINO。

overview.en: Virgo Surgical, a medical video solutions provider, uses Google Cloud Storage and Google Kubernetes Engine to host and process over 1.75 petabytes of endoscopy video data. This massive dataset has been used to create EndoDINO, an AI foundation model for endoscopy that achieves high performance across medical imaging applications, representing the largest dataset of its kind.
overview.zh: 醫療影像解決方案提供商 Virgo Surgical 使用 Google Cloud Storage 與 Google Kubernetes Engine 儲存並處理逾 1.75 PB 的內視鏡影片資料。這一龐大資料集已用於創建內視鏡 AI 基礎模型 EndoDINO，在醫療影像應用中達到高水準表現，是同類資料集中規模最大的。

en: Stores 1.75+ petabytes of endoscopy video in Google Cloud Storage.
Google Kubernetes Engine enables flexible scaling of video ingestion and processing.
EndoDINO foundation model trained on 130,037 de-identified endoscopy videos with 3.5 billion frames.
AI foundation model achieves state-of-the-art performance across endoscopy benchmarks.
zh: 在 Google Cloud Storage 中儲存逾 1.75 PB 的內視鏡影片。
Google Kubernetes Engine 支援影片擷取與處理的靈活擴展。
EndoDINO 基礎模型在 13 萬份去識別化內視鏡影片（35 億幀）上訓練。
AI 基礎模型在內視鏡基準測試中達到最先進的表現。
